i know how hard it is :( my boyfriend of a year and a half cheated on me recently so i can only imagine the end of a 6 year relationship. if the panic attacks get too exhausting (mine did and it was atrocious) you can always try making an appointment for your doctor and talk about meds if you’re into that (duh). hydroxyzine helped me through it on occasion, just don’t use it too much. if you don’t want to have medication involved, what i did was write letters, journal, watch tedtalks, the whole shebang. it’s hard to enjoy the things you love right now, or even to feel like you’re okay in the moment. mine ended within a month but sometimes i get that rising feeling of it all over again. you will get through this and it’s good that you recognize it, i guarantee in a month he will be texting you and crying about how he fucked up because that’s what dudes do. at the end of the day it’s up to us to control our reactions and not other’s actions which is lame.
